entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 4.2.0.173 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 4.2.0.173 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Issues resolved as part of version 4.1.0.102 for Windows were also included in this release. Refer to the Windows 4.1.0.102 release notes for details.
- Fixes an issue where machine tunnel enrollment failed because of an issue with the policy download.
- Fixes an issue with anti-tampering by adding additional configurations for registry protection.
- Fixes an issue where the Force ZPA Reauthentication feature did not work as expected in some conditions.
- Fixes an issue where adding partner tenants failed due to an issue in domain name validation.
- Fixes an intermittent issue where bypassed traffic didn’t get excluded due to a race condition in some scenarios.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 4.1.0.102 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 4.1.0.102 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where some users received a Driver Error for ZPA when installing a lightweight filter driver with GlobalProtect VPN enabled.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector was uninstalled after an auto-upgrade from Windows Zscaler Client Connector version 3.7.1.53 to Windows Zscaler Client Connector version 4.0.0.89.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector app profile bypasses didn’t work in scenarios where the default interface had more than one IP address.
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Deception service failed to update in some scenarios.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.7.1.31 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.7.1.31 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports Webex Call Quality Management (CQM) for Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX.
- Fixes an issue where multiple notifications were sent frequently due to a crash in the ZDX module.
- Fixes an issue where the ZDX Admin Portal was missing the PCAP File Path during a deep tracing session.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 4.1.0.98 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 4.1.0.98 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where upgrading to Zscaler Client Connector version 4.0.0.70 caused the ZSATrayManager service to go to 25% CPU usage in a VDI pool.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) didn’t connect and displayed the Connection Error message on Zscaler Client Connector version 3.9.0.175 for Windows.
- Fixes an issue where some users experienced PAC configuration issues when connected to a VPN Trusted Network.

- Fixes an issue where the nslookup command, which targets a DNS request to a specific DNS server by domain, failed on devices running Zscaler Client Connector with only an IPv4 address if the DNS domain is a Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) application. To learn more, see DNS Request Failure in Zscaler Client Connector version 4.1.0.89.
- Fixes an issue where users lost access to internal resources after upgrading to Zscaler Client Connector version 4.1.0.82.
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Client Connector system tray icon displayed the Service is Disabled message, although no services were affected.
- Fixes an issue where disabling Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) did not always prompt users to enter a reason for disabling the service.

- Fixes an issue where Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams applications were not accessible in Tunnel with Local Proxy (TWLP). To learn more, see Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams Not Accessible.

- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector didn't evaluate the Detect Antivirus posture type within the usual time frame after a reboot because of a race condition with the Windows Security Center Service.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 4.2 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 4.2 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports configuring dynamic Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Public Service Edge use based on latency settings for the probe interval, frequency, and threshold limit. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Assigns a virtual IP address to Zscaler Client Connector to support some Server-to-Client applications such as remote troubleshooting and software distribution.
- Adds the ability to configure the VPN name for flow logging.

- Adds configurations to display critical notifications until users dismiss them for Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) reauthentication, system reboot requests, captive portal, and packet capture. To learn more, see Configuring End User Notifications for Zscaler Client Connector.

- Enhances the built-in browser for IdP authentication by using WebView2 based on configuration. Supports multi-factor authentication (MFA) and Fast Identity Online (FIDO) authentication methods for YubiKey.

- Supports configuring a one-time password (OTP) to disable anti-tampering and an option to reactivate anti-tampering after a user disables it, and enables the Zscaler Endpoint Protection (ZEP) driver to accept root CA certificate validation for trusted processes in the ZEP policy. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Enhances the Learn More link with new error codes reported by Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports tracking the Zscaler Client Connector upgrade history (i.e., version) and date and time the version was installed.
- Adds additional end user notification controls configured in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Supports force reverting to a previous version in the Zscaler Client Connector App Store. To learn more, see About the Zscaler Client Connector Store.
- Supports blocking access to keyboard shortcuts and the drag-and-drop procedure in Zscaler Client Connector WebBrowser Control (WBC).
- Supports configuring advance authentication notification alerts for ZPA applications. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports including browser-based configurations in keepalive policy downloads.
- Supports the PcapNG file format for packet capture.

- Adds a configurable option to force ZPA authentication if a user’s computer goes into sleep or hibernation, on system restart, or because of a network IP change. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports configuring a preferred port to enable Zscaler Client Connector to SME server communication. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Improves accessibility with keyboard navigation.
- Ensures that new Digital Experience (ZDX) versions remain compatible with older Zscaler Client Connector versions.
- Allows configuration of the default RDP 3389 bypass.
- Supports the Windows 365 platform with some additional configuration. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector for Microsoft 365 Cloud PCs.
- Improves the process of updating a large number of GPO rules during the Windows logon process.
- Supports Advanced RISC Machines (ARM) architecture in 64-bit with AMD64 builds in compatibility mode. ARM64 is not natively supported.
- Supports ZPA client-to-client (C2C) remote assistance for Azure Active Directory (AD) domain-joined and hybrid-joined devices, while still supporting enterprise local domain-joined devices.
- Removes support of legacy cipher suites from Zscaler Client Connector TLS connections.

- Supports adding certificate template information of the issued certificate for the Client Certificate posture type to confirm that the certificate contains the correct value. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles.

- Provides the ability to use the Zscaler Client Connector synthetic IP range on the LAN address space, based on Zscaler Client Connector Portal configuration. To learn more, see Configuring the Zscaler Client Connector Synthetic IP Range. (CVE-2023-28803).
- Supports the SCCM VPN Boundary method with ZPA to support client-initiated SCCM use cases for content delivery.
- Fixes an issue where reauthentication failed after users' systems woke up from hibernation.
- Fixes an issue where a logon script lost connectivity when Zscaler Client Connector transitioned from machine tunnel to user tunnel.
- Fixes an issue where, in some configurations, users received a blank IdP page after logging out and then logging back in when not connected to a VPN.
- Fixes an issue where a client-to-client (C2C) request timed out before forwarding the ICMP request over ZPA.
- Fixes an issue where traffic received an SSL handshake error if the maximum transmission unit (MTU) was incorrectly set.

- Improves DNS inclusions and exclusions for Z-Tunnel 2.0 by comparing the DNS Domains and matching against the longest domain name suffix. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector wasn’t using the configured cipher suite in the TLS connection to SVPN.
- Fixes an issue where users were disconnected from ZPA and the connection on port 443 couldn't be established because of a configuration change in the ZPA Admin Portal.
- Fixes an issue where users were not able to bypass the 100.64.1.0 -100.64.255.255 subnet traffic when added to a VPN bypass or the Destination Exclusions list for ZIA customers only.
- Fixes an issue where users received an internal error in Zscaler Client Connector when connecting to the network on a docking station because the local DNS proxy did not restart.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not tunnel DNS traffic over TCP for Z-Tunnel 2.0.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector fell back to IP address 8.8.8.8/8.8.4.4 on port 53 when no system DNS server was detected.
- Fixes an issue where a user could disable ZIA or ZPA from the Machine Tunnel diagnostics page without a password. (CVE-2023-28802).

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.22
body: - Syncs department information from Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and displays it on the Device Details page in Enrolled Devices.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.6.0.68 for Windows

body: - Improves the tunnel detection logic using web probe caching when HTTP probes are disabled on the network.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 4.1.0.82 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 4.1.0.82 Enhancements and Fixes

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.5.0.59 for Windows

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.3.1.52 for Windows

body: - Improves egress detection more accurately and uses it as a destination for the reverse cloud path from Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Public Service Edge or ZIA Private Service Edge.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 4.1 for Windows

Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature for your organization.

- Fixes Zscaler Client Connector’s detection where it sets the VPN as the default interface route.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.3.1.50 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.3.1.50 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue related to missing cloud path data due to the NPCAP installation failure.
- Fixes a crash issue in the uploader module due to a malformed redirect URL.
- Fixes a TCP traceroute cloud path error by using the hops data from adaptive trace route.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.4.0.40 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.4.0.40 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes absent cloud path data due to the failed installation of Network Capture (NCAP) from the Tray Manager.
- Fixes an issue where ZDX reported the USE_ADAPTIVE error for a properly configured adaptive probe.
- Fixes a TCP/UDP traceroutes failure due to incorrect adapter names from Nmap Project's packet capture (NPCAP) library 1.0.
- Fixes an uploader crash due to the redirect URL containing a semicolon.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.5 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.5 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Adds remote packet capture capabilities.
- Adjusts the timeout for tunnel detection logic to attain more accurate results in high latency networks.
- Reduces CPU consumption by optimizing database I/O operations.
- Updates the process stats metrics to report top processes based on peak values.
- Fixes an issue where ZDX crashes when the system resumes from sleep.
- Fixes an issue where ZDX connects to Telemetry and Policy Gateway (TPG) with an extremely short retry interval in the case of an error from TPG.
- Fixes an issue where ZDX failed to get device profile fields under certain conditions.
- Fixes an issue where ZDX reports the USE_ADAPTIVE error for a properly configured adaptive probe.
- Fixes calculation errors in end hop traceroute results when using adaptive traceroute.
- Fixes an issue related to Nmap Project's packet capture (NPCAP) when ZDX interacts with point-to-point (PPP)-based VPNs.
- Fixes TCP/UDP traceroutes failure due to incorrect adapter names from Nmap Project's packet capture (NPCAP) library 1.0.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.21.2
body: - Improves how long the DNS cache manages time-to-live (TTL) for all OS types.
- Provides the option to have Zscaler Client Connector collect logs per device.
- Provides the ability to use the Web 2.0 web browser control in Zscaler Client Connector.
- Includes the option to intercept Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) traffic from any network adapter in the Zscaler Client Connector profile.
- Updates Swagger to version 3.0.
- Includes public API information in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal audit logs.
- Provides the option to disable the Zscaler firewall for macOS if ZIA is active. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Includes the ability to enable or disable the exclusion DNS servers in the routing table for macOS. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Adds a link to the Zscaler Client Connector APIs from the Public API page in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.

- Renames the Personal Computers tab in the Zscaler Client Connector Store page to Registered Devices, and moves the Revert Zscaler Client Connector option from the Zscaler Client Connector Registered Device Details window to the Registered Devices tab.
- Improves the table pagination on the Enrolled Devices page in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Provides an anti-tampering solution for processes, services, files, and registry keys. To learn more, see Anti-Tampering for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports configuring a preferred port to enable Zscaler Client Connector to SME server communication. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Fixes an issue where an invalid request for a device list using the Public APIs did not return a bad request response.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.3.1.47 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.3.1.47 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where the tunnel detection fails due to a short timeout on the HTTP request in high latency environments.
- Fixes an issue where ZDX reports the USE_ADAPTIVE error for a properly configured adaptive probe.
- Fixes TCP/UDP traceroutes failure due to incorrect adapter names from Nmap Project's packet capture (NPCAP) library 1.0.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 4.0 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 4.0 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports Data Loss Prevention notifications.
- Zscaler Client Connector supports ARM processor-based Windows machines with operating systems running Windows 10 or 11.
- Provides separate one-time passwords (OTPs) for the logout and uninstall functions.
- Adds External Device ID value in Device Details.
- Adds support for posture-based risk profiles for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA).
- Provides Disaster Recovery options when ZIA is not reachable.
- Provides Disaster Recovery options when ZPA is not reachable.
- Automatically updates application bypass for common applications on Z-Tunnel 2.0.
- Upgrades Npcap to version 1.71 for Intel and Advanced RISC Machines (ARM).
- Updates the Lightweight Filter (LWF) driver to improve performance and packet handling.
- Supports dropping inbound access to Zscaler Client Connector listening ports when in packet filter mode.
- Supports a fallback option that validates the Detect Microsoft Defender posture type when the certificate matching thumbprint check fails.
- Supports a network mounted user profile folder in a non-persistent VDI environment.
- Provides visibility into traffic bypassed from ZIA.
- Adds verification using proof key for code exchange (PKCE) with ZIA for user enrollment (CVE-2023-28799) and an associated XSS vulnerability (CVE-2023-28800).
- Fixes an issue where users were unable to connect to Wi-Fi on airplanes due to captive portal detection not working.
- Fixes an issue where the computer name in the ZPA IdP Metadata field was different from the name in the Machine Hostname field in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Fixes an issue where a deleted application segment blocked traffic.
- Fixes an issue where cloud path data appeared only intermittently.
- Fixes an issue where a quarantined device received a Connection Error but still connected.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector stopped tunneling traffic.
- Fixes an issue where PAC files published through Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) couldn’t be downloaded after upgrading.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.9.0.175 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.9.0.175 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports a new configurable endpoint for captive detection that won’t be bypassed from some captive portals.
- Improves the handling of duplicate DNS suffixes when configured via Zscaler Private Access (ZPA).
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not detect the captive portal in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where the RDP session was disconnected when a user ran the session through the client-to-client ZPA. For more information, see About Client-Based Remote Assistance.
- Fixes an issue where the service discovery did not correctly detect the proxy with enforce proxy configuration on trusted networks.
- Fixes an issue where the registry key Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Zscaler Inc. was missing on Windows 32-bit OS.
- Fixes the network connectivity issue in the Drop IPv6 feature.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector authentication was not successful when using browser-based authentication.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.21.1
body: - Supports using the keyboard to select the Launch button on the landing page when using browser-based authentication.
- Supports downloading the browser-based configuration in the keepalive policy download.
- Adds a public API to download enrolled devices information as a CSV file.
- Allows administrators to configure an option to notify users that per-app VPN tunnel establishment is in progress for iOS devices. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports a test mode for disaster recovery for selected app profiles. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports authentication using the default browser for iOS. To learn more, see About Authentication Settings.
- Supports disabling and enabling Zscaler Client Connector proxies on VPN adapters. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Updates the range of the value you can enter for MTU for Zscaler Adapter to between 800 and 1400. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports adding Zoom and Microsoft Teams bypass IPs to VPN Gateways.
- Supports prohibiting the installation or upgrade of Zscaler Client Connector for macOS versions 3.7 or later on macOS Mojave 10.14.
- Updates the minimum value for the CrowdStrike ZTA posture type Minimum Score from zero to one. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.
- Supports multiple one-time passwords (OTP) for different functions.
- Supports the Detect Microsoft Defender posture type for Linux.
- Supports the OS Version posture type for Linux.
- Supports the Full Disk Encryption posture type for Linux.
- Fixes an issue where users lost access to Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) and were forced to log out after some devices were removed through an API request.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.4.0.38 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.4.0.38 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Adds recovery from ZDX database corruption.
- Fixes continuous retry on Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) initialization failure.
- Fixes ZDX crash issue when the system resumes from sleep.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.3.1.45 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.3.1.45 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Adds recovery from ZDX database corruption.
- Fixes continuous retry on Event Tracing for Windows (ETW) initialization failure.
- Fixes missing Cloud Path data by preventing DB corruption during shutdown.
- Fixes ZDX crash issue when the system resumes from sleep.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.9.0.160 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.9.0.160 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where Z-Tunnel 2.0 connections for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) were unstable in dual stack networks.
- Fixes issues with IPv6 DNS packet handling.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.9 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.9 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Enables customers to configure fallback options on Z-Tunnel 2.0 establishment failure. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports non-persistent VDI support changes. To learn more, see Customizing Zscaler Client Connector with Install Options for MSI.
- Supports a customizable list of VPN Trusted Network names to accurately detect VPN Trusted Networks. To learn more, see About the Endpoint Integration Page.
- Supports skipping trusted network criteria evaluation for Split VPN Trusted Network detection. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports running Zscaler Client Connector installs on Amazon Workspaces.
- Supports assigning specific entitlements to devices based on posture. To learn more, see About Device Groups and About Zscaler Entitlement.
- Supports Zscaler Deception integration with Zscaler Client Connector. To learn more, see About Zscaler Client Connector Integration with Deception.
- Supports the ability to revert Zscaler Client Connector to the previously installed version. To learn more, see Reverting Zscaler Client Connector to the Previous Version.
- Supports pausing notifications in Zscaler Client Connector. To learn more, see Viewing Notifications on Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports the Certificate Trust and Client Certificate posture types for the pre-Windows login machine tunnel. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.
- Adds the option Fallback to Gateway Domain to use when PAC proxies cannot be reached for Z-Tunnel 1.0. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Improves Z-Tunnel 2.0 performance by optimizing the decision-making process for packets.
- Adds verification using proof key for code exchange (PKCE) with Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) for user enrollment (CVE-2023-28799) and an associated XSS vulnerability (CVE-2023-28800).
- Fixes an issue where users remained authenticated and the machine tunnel remained on after rebooting if they did not log in to the workstation.
- Fixes an issue where some traffic was sent directly from the user’s machine in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector didn’t recognize the trusted network connection after a connection with the Checkpoint VPN client was established.
- Fixes an issue where the machine tunnel remained active even after it was removed from the app profile.

- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector bypassed traffic because it selected a single physical network adapter as the default and didn’t correctly select other active physical network adapters.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.4 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.4 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Adds improvements to reduce the upload delay duration for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Improves Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) proxy detection by using all specific proxies for the selected domain in the app profile.
- Fixes the calculation of the ZDX score when Windows machines enter Modern Standby mode and probing is still on.
- Fixes the missing application name on the end server.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.21
body: - Adds ID fields for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) to audit logs streaming to SIEM. This only applies to customers with either ZIA or ZIA and ZPA.
- Provides visibility into traffic bypassed from ZIA.
- Adds the Fallback to Gateway Domain option to use when PAC proxies cannot be reached for Z-Tunnel 1.0. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports using the read and read/write roles in the token for API CRUD (create, read, update, and delete) operations.
- Supports using role-based access (RBA) to provide Zscaler Support access to the Zscaler Client Connector Portal when using Remote Assistance.
- Supports assigning specific entitlements to devices based on posture. To learn more, see About Device Groups and About Zscaler Entitlement.
- Supports the ability to revert Zscaler Client Connector to the previously installed version. To learn more, see Reverting Zscaler Client Connector to the Previous Version.
- Supports Zscaler Deception integration with Zscaler Client Connector. To learn more, see Enabling Deception for a Group of Users.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.8.0.102 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.8.0.102 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where Windows bypassed Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) when switching to a different NIC.
- Fixes an issue where users could change proxy settings when Enable Firefox Integration was enabled in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector failed to build Z-Tunnel 2.0 with versions 3.7 and 3.8 and fell back to Z-Tunnel 1.0.
- Fixes an issue where users working from home experienced intermittent outages.
- Fixes an issue where users weren’t connecting to the closest data center because the PAC file download request was tunneled through ZIA.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector reconnected every 30 seconds.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.3.1 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.3.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Updates the page fetch metrics for TCP connection time, SSL handshake time, processing of HTTP requests and response, server response time for Web Probes, and Forward Method.
- Improves the detection of egress.
- Improves error reporting for internet connectivity when internet access is not available to address the misreported DNS resolution error.
- Improves error reporting for web probe when IPv6 is returned.
- Improves error reporting when egress is not reachable.
- Supports cloud path handling when the public IP addresses are used on a private network.
- Supports health metrics and Zscaler Client Connector reports the process contributing most to CPU, Memory, Network I/O, and Disk I/O usage.
- Provides error code reporting when DNS resolution happens with DNS V6 only.
- Fixes an issue where the gateway IP did not appear in the cloud path in some scenarios.
- Fixes Gateway node type when the gateway and the egress are the same hop.
- Fixes an issue to report the status when egress is not reachable.
- Fixes the number of packets when a cloud path probe runs on a corporate network.
- Fixes the set egress IP field when there is no GRE/IPSec Tunnel.
- Fixes internet connectivity break when Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) listens to PPP-based VPNs.
- Fixes high memory consumption on Zscaler Client Connector with ZDX 3.3.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.8.0.100 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.8.0.100 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Improves the Z-Tunnel 2.0 teardown and deadlock detection functionality to avoid and recover from deadlocks.
- Fixes an issue where users remained authenticated and the machine tunnel remained on after rebooting if they did not log in to the workstation.
- Fixes an issue with Crowdstrike Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) integration.
- Fixes an issue where users were able to access the internet directly even though Zscaler Client Connector was on and enabled.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not recognize the trusted network connection after a connection with the Checkpoint VPN client was established.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.20.0.231
body: - Supports the posture type Process Check for Linux. For more information, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.3 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.3 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports a single leg in the cloud path from Zscaler Client Connector to the application on private networks.
- Supports the device inventory plugin to collect user, vendor, OS, and hardware information.
- Supports the ZIA Private Service Edge in the cloud path.
- Improves response time for Adaptive probes in Deep Tracing.
- Improves latency measurements by performing a traceroute in the cloud path to the ZIA Public Service Edge or ZIA Private Service Edge.
- Removes Adaptive traceroute to egress, since egress for each probe can be different.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.8 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.8 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Enhances the strict enforcement feature to block all ports and protocols.
- Supports using the Zscaler Client Connector Notification Framework. To learn more, see About the Zscaler Notification Framework.
- Supports protecting sensitive and personal information in logs by restricting access to the Zscaler Program Data folder to only System Administrators.

- Adds two new options for the Z-Tunnel 2.0 protocol bypass feature: Redirect Web Traffic to ZCC Listening Proxy and Use Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Proxied Web Traffic. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client.
- Supports overriding the Z-Tunnel 2.0 protocol settings by adding a new option on the User Privacy page. To learn more, see About User Privacy.

- Supports the ability for Zscaler Client Connector to detect if a device is running a split-tunnel VPN in addition to the currently supported full tunnel VPN Trusted Network detection. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Allows Zscaler Client Connector to evaluate trusted network criteria against all default route adapters. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports rate-limiting in tray notifications to suppress frequent and duplicate notifications. To learn more, see About the Zscaler Notification Framework.
- Supports enabling the Zscaler Notification Framework as an alternative to the default Windows notification system. To learn more, see About the Zscaler Notification Framework.
- Supports Npcap version 1.6 for ARM architecture-based machines.
- Adds verification using proof key for code exchange (PKCE) with Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) for user enrollment (CVE-2023-28799) and an associated XSS vulnerability (CVE-2023-28800).
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector processed machines as being Off Trusted Network when using VPNs in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where users can’t reopen the Zscaler Client Connector window and are instead prompted to log in using their browser.
- Fixes an issue where, in some scenarios, device posture evaluation for the firewall posture type fails.
- Fixes an issue where the client’s certificate is not checked by the Certificate Revocation List (CRL), producing inconsistent device posture evaluations.
- Fixes an issue where automatic reauthentication fails, and users have to click Authenticate to access Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) applications.
- Fixes an issue where the client-side certificate posture check was skipped after starting Zscaler Client Connector.
- Fixes an issue where a ZDX password was used to disable ZIA.
- Fixes an issue that handles non-standard ASCII characters in the user configuration, which requires users to log in again after rebooting.
- Fixes an issue where if Tunnel Internal Client Connector Traffic is selected, all DNS queries go inside the tunnel even if an asterisk (*) is entered in the Domain Inclusion for DNS Requests field.
- Fixes an inconsistent Apply On Network Change behavior while executing the proxy configuration.
- Fixes an issue by adding retry logic when a Z-Tunnel 1.0 request failed with an authentication required error (407).
- Fixes an issue where the machine tunnel service could not be restarted.
- Fixes a compatibility issue with the AnyConnect client where ZDX web probes on applications failed through ZIA.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.7.2.18 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7.2.18 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where the install parameters, like the cloud name, were not carried forward when upgrading Zscaler Client Connector from Windows 3.4. or Windows 3.4.1.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.7.1.56 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7.1.56 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where the install parameters, like the cloud name, were not carried forward when upgrading Zscaler Client Connector from Windows 3.4. or Windows 3.4.1.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.20.1
body: The following updates are for release 3.20 refresh 1 (a.k.a., 3.20.1):

- Supports increasing the device token limit from 8 to 16. For more information, see Creating a Device Token.
- Supports enabling the Zscaler Notification Framework as an alternative to the default Windows notification system. To learn more, see About the Zscaler Notification Framework.
- Supports authentication using the default browser for Linux. To learn more, see About Authentication Settings.
- Supports skipping trusted network criteria evaluation for Split VPN Trusted Network detection. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports a customizable list of VPN Trusted Network names to accurately detect VPN Trusted Networks. To learn more, see About the Endpoint Integration Page.
- Supports authentication using the default browser for Android. To learn more, see About Authentication Settings.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.7.2 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7.2 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Provides the ability to specify a unique username for each machine by adding the username parameter to the command-line interface.
- Fixes an issue where automatic re-authentication fails, and users have to click Authenticate to access internal Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) applications.
- Fixes an issue where the client’s certificate was not checked by the Certificate Revocation List (CRL), producing inconsistent device posture evaluations.
- Fixes an issue where device posture evaluation for the firewall posture type fails and users cannot access ZPA applications.
- Fixes an issue where users can’t reopen the Zscaler Client Connector window to log in if, after installation, users closed the window without logging in.
- Fixes an issue where the Z-Tunnel 2.0 include and exclude rules were not working if the port and protocols were specified in the rules.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.7.1.54 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7.1.54 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where the Z-Tunnel 2.0 include and exclude rules were not working if the port and protocols were specified in the rules.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.20
body: - Supports selecting specific devices and registration details to create a filtered list for enrolled devices. To learn more, see About Enrolled Devices.

- Supports new status details when remotely fetching logs from the device: Waiting for KeepAlive, Extraction in progress, Completed, Error while fetching logs. To learn more, see Viewing Device Fingerprint for an Enrolled Device.

To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports using terms allowlist and denylist to describe managing access.

- Provides administrators the control to configure an automatic update of 64-bit images of Zscaler Client Connector for specific groups. To learn more, see Adding a Zscaler Client Connector Store Group Policy and Configuring Update Settings for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Improves error messages when configuring trusted networks or device postures.
- Supports overriding the Z-Tunnel 2.0 protocol settings by adding a new option on the User Privacy page. To learn more, see About User Privacy.

- Supports the ability for Zscaler Client Connector to detect if a device is running a split-tunnel VPN in addition to the currently supported full tunnel VPN Trusted Network detection. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.

- Enables customers to configure fallback options on Z-Tunnel 2.0 establishment failure. To learn more, Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports the Certificate Trust and Client Certificate posture types for the pre-Windows login machine tunnel. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.
- Adds posture-based risk profiles for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA). To learn more, see About ZIA Posture Profiles.
- Supports configuring role-based administration within the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. To learn more, see Administration Management.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.7.0.92 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7.0.92 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Improves the performance of ZPA applications by implementing a socket option in Zscaler Client Connector that has no delays.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector experienced a connection error after the machine was locked or in sleep mode in some scenarios.

- Fixes an issue where VPN bypasses were not followed for DNS traffic containing IPv6 addresses, which prevented the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Cloud Path from reporting information for some end users.

- Fixes an issue where the PAC file bypass failed when using a VPN on 3.6.
- Fixes an issue where ZOOM traffic was not bypassed from Zscaler Client Connector as configured.

- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not recognize the Checkpoint VPN in 3.5.0.108.
- Fixes an issue where DNS requests were bypassing Z-Tunnel 2.0 on machines when the Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) assigned the IP address.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.7.1.53 for Windows

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.2 for Windows

body: - Supports the No Default Route (NDR) environment in the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) None mode.
- Includes support to enable or disable FIPS mode.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.6.1.26 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.6.1.26 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector ran into an error state after users authenticated from a Captive Portal.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector experienced a connection error after the machine was locked or in sleep mode in some scenarios.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.7.1 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports configuring how Zscaler Client Connector works in tunnel mode by binding to the default adapter or by binding to a specific interface to support Split VPN (exclude routes).
- Supports configuring how Zscaler Client Connector detects trusted networks by sending the DNS requests through the default adapter.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.1 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Adds resiliency with failover to a secondary Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) server in some scenarios.
- Improves data upload efficiencies to the ZDX server.
- Limits up to 30 active monitors per device.
- Adds improvements to reduce the CPU footprint of the ZDX module.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.7 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Zscaler Client Connector no longer supports Windows 7 and Windows 8. To learn more, see Upgrading to Zscaler Client Connector 3.7 for Windows.
- Provides the ability to connect from one Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) enabled Zscaler Client Connector to another for application-like remote assistance.

- Supports running Zscaler Client Connector as a 64-bit application. During upgrades, 32-bit versions will continue to upgrade to 32-bit versions. If you are interested in the 64-bit version, contact the Zscaler Account team to enable it for your organization.
- Provides a more descriptive subject line for emails that admins receive when users complete the Report an Issue form.
- Includes support of internal tunnel traffic in tunnel mode, in addition to the Tunnel with Local Proxy (TWLP) mode.

- Provides a text field in the Zscaler Client Connector app to explain the reason for disabling a service. This field only appears if the disable password field is configured in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Improves how Clear Logs in the Zscaler Client Connector app treats log files for the current session.
- Improves log file size handling.
- Changes how Zscaler Client Connector measures device fingerprints.
- Improves how error messages display in the Zscaler Client Connector app for end users.
- Includes a new error handling for when devices are in a quarantine state.
- Improves the way AUP messages appear in the Zscaler Client Connector app for end users.
- Zscaler Client Connector now supports Windows 11.
- Improves manual policy download requests when initiated in Zscaler Client Connector.
- Adds verification using proof key for code exchange (PKCE) with Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) for user enrollment (CVE-2023-28799) and an associated XSS vulnerability (CVE-2023-28800).

- Fixes an issue where username information displayed when authenticating with an IdP through Zscaler Client Connector, even though the corresponding setting was disabled in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector goes into an error state when the Registering Devices with ZPA IdP Username setting was enabled for customers using both ZIA and ZPA.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector paused in a Connecting state in some instances when machine tunnel configurations were in use.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector paused in a Connecting state in some instances when a malformed DNS query response was sent.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector ran into an error state in some instances when automatic reauthentication for ZPA was in use.
- Fixes an issue where packet capture failed to start on some devices with Intel/AMD processors.
- Fixes an issue where RDP connections failed for physical and VDI devices when Zscaler Client Connector was upgraded from version 1.5 to 3.1.
- Fixes an issue where ZPA applications slowed when running Zscaler Client Connector on a trusted network.
- Fixes a ZPA authentication issue where end users were prompted to reauthenticate multiple times when the VPN bypass hostname list contained hundreds of domains.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector ran into an error state after users authenticated from a Captive Portal.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector upgrade on Windows devices resulted in a denial-of-service and privilege escalation through RPC Control (CVE-2023-41971).

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.6.1.23 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.6.1.23 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Improves the performance of ZPA applications by implementing a socket option in Zscaler Client Connector that has no delays.
- Fixes an issue where the Detect Antivirus posture type fails during machine reboots in some scenarios.
- Fixes a memory leak issue that caused posture policy evaluations to fail for CrowdStrike.
- Fixes an issue where the posture check on the CrowdStrike ZTA score failed as the device woke from a sleep state.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.0.0.59 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.0.0.59 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where multiple Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) requests caused the SOHO gateway to stop responding to the ARP requests for some time, resulting in an Internet connectivity break.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 2.3.1.16 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 2.3.1.16 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where multiple Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) requests caused the SOHO gateway to stop responding to the ARP requests for some time, resulting in an Internet connectivity break.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.6.1.20 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.6.1.20 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where, in some scenarios, Zscaler Client Connector failed to upgrade when the policy token parameter was used during installation.
- Fixes an issue where the VPN trusted network detection was not reliably working in Tunnel With Local Proxy (TWLP) mode when using the legacy TAP driver.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector ran into an error state after users were prompted to reauthenticate.
- Fixes an issue where users intermittently had to reauthenticate after a system reboot with Zscaler Client Connector version 3.6 in some scenarios.

- Fixes an issue where, in some scenarios, Zscaler Client Connector was sending application traffic through Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) even though there was a client forwarding policy configured to bypass ZPA on a trusted network.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.19
body: - Increased the minimum Zscaler Client Connector logging size configuration from 10 MB to 50 MB.
- Includes showing the date and time when devices were unregistered or removed as part of the exported information for devices.
- Supports OS-based posture checks for macOS. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.
- Supports 32-bit architecture for ARM processor devices.
- Supports antivirus-based posture checks for macOS. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.
- Supports configuring the Zscaler Client Connector to follow the routing table for connections or bind to the default interface. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Includes updates to the Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) frequency options, and supports configuration of AUP information that is sent to the Zscaler Client Connector.

- Includes option to view and enable available releases (General Availability and Limited Availability) from the Client Connector App Store. To learn more, see About the Zscaler Client Connector Store.

- Supports sending the reason a Zscaler service was disabled on a device to the Zscaler Client Connector Portal, which is viewable in the registered device details. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Removes the License chart in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal Dashboard for customers with only ZPA, as it is only relevant for ZIA.
- Includes the option to bind the DNS request to the default adapter. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports Windows 64-bit for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Fixes an issue where administrators with view-only access were unable to view audit logs.
- Fixes an issue where the entire Machine token appeared in the exported machine tunnel file.
- Fixes an issue with the misalignment of headers and columns in the exported service status information.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.6.1 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.6.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) applications in the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Cloud Path. To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
- Adds a permission check in the ZSATray to read geolocation information only if enabled at both the user and machine level.
- The Certutil.exe file needed on allowlists was renamed to ZSFFutil.exe. To learn more, see Zscaler Client Connector Processes to Allowlist.
- The zrdt library log now has its own log files. The file name is ZSATunnel_zrdt_2021-*.log.
- Fixes an issue with the registry value when manually upgrading Zscaler Client Connector from 3.5.0.108.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 3.0 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 3.0 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports increasing the limit of traceroute probes to more than 30.
- Fixes an issue where the web load failed to stop after a device went into sleep mode.
- Fixes an issue where a Hop count restriction did not accommodate a traceroute to broker path with both Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) enabled.
- Fixes an issue where an application’s URL delimiter caused inconsistencies in the ZDX Admin Portal UI.
- Fixes an issue where data was not available for the cloud path when using the DNS name for the Global VIP.
- Fixes an issue where the Device Health stats for Zscaler Network Adapter were displaying an inconsistent maximum bandwidth.
- Fixes an issue where the SME signature was not recognized in the traceroute path.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector was not using the BGP port for traceroute to egress.
- Fixes an MTR issue by using BGP port 179 in the reverse egress path from the SME.
- Fixes an issue where IP addresses were duplicated in the cloud path in some scenarios.
- Fixes a UDP port issue to ensure successful UDP traffic.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.18.0.112
body: - Includes new options for disabling parallel IPv6 and IPv4 DNS requests. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 2.3.1.14 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 2.3.1.14 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where VPN split-tunneling caused the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) service to restart.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 2.3.1 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 2.3.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where a Windows 10 language pack caused partial display of device metrics for Device Health status.
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) cloud path was showing an incorrect location for the user.
- Fixes an issue where the ZDX probes were doing a direct connection instead of going through the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) tunnels in certain exclude route scenarios.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.6 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.6 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Upgrades the version of InstallBuilder, which includes several security enhancements.
- Includes support for SCCM Cloud Management Gateway by configuring a Zscaler Client Connector Portal setting.
- Provides support for antivirus signature status posture checks, as configured in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Provides support for password protecting the disabling of the Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) service, as configured in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Provides support for the current status of ZDX, ZIA, and ZPA, as seen in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Includes security enhancements for the Pre-Windows Login with IdP feature.
- Provides security enhancements to Zscaler service by safeguarding the Zscaler root folder in the Windows registry.
- Provides support for browser based authentication, as configured in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.
- Includes additional restrictions on accessing Zscaler Client Connector user config files.
- Improves how much of the App Policy name displays in Zscaler Client Connector by dynamically adjusting based on the size of the window.
- Fixes an issue where the Z-Tunnel 2.0 fell back to Z-Tunnel 1.0 in rare scenarios involving VPNs.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector remained in a Connecting state when using Citrix VPN in some scenarios.
- Addresses an issue where Zscaler Client Connector remained in an error state in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector goes into an error state after the system woke up from a sleep state or when there was a change in network.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector goes into an error state when the custom Listening Port setting is configured for Machine Tunnel scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector remained in a Connecting state after the system woke up from a hibernation state.
- Fixes an issue where the installer and uninstaller had an unquoted search path. (CVE-2021-26735 and CVE-2021-26736)

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.18
body: - Includes option to enable Browser Based Authentication in the Administration settings for Windows. To learn more, see About Authentication Settings.
- Includes option to configure Windows Zscaler Client Connector profiles for SCCM. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports antivirus-based posture checks for Windows. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.
- Includes option to export service information for enrolled devices. To learn more, About Enrolled Devices.
- Supports OS-based posture checks for Windows.
- Provides ability to password protect the disabling of the Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) service. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports quarantining for enrolled devices.
- Includes tooltips for app profile fields to display entire text strings in cases where the strings have been truncated.
- Includes options for enrolled devices to filter active devices by periods of time and to search by Device ID, UDID, Machine Name, or Hardware Fingerprint.
- Device hostname and owner will now only be shown in the Registered Device Details screen if the settings have been enabled in the User Privacy tab.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.5.0.108 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.5.0.108 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Adds restrictions on user actions for the Pre-Windows Login IdP feature if the SAML authentication page provides links to open in a browser.
- Fixes an issue where some users briefly saw a network error when switching to a trusted network with their VPN from a non-trusted network.
- Fixes an issue where the Process Check for some posture profiles were failing due to access restrictions on the process.
- Fixes an issue where the default forwarding profile is used instead of the cached forwarding profile when a network state change occurs to the Tunnel With Local Proxy (TWLP) mode.
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) probes were doing a direct connection instead of going through the ZIA tunnels in certain exclude route scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where the geolocation information was not reported correctly during the system wakeup or boot times in the ZDX UI.
- Fixes an issue where the Z-Tunnel 2.0 fell back to Z-Tunnel 1.0 in rare scenarios involving VPNs.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector was stuck in a Connecting state when the Disable loopback restrictions option was used.
- Fixes an issue where browser traffic was a direct connection in very rare scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector experienced a network error state in no default route environments.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.5 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.5 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Includes support for the ICMP protocol over Zscaler Private Access (ZPA).
- Includes the ability to drop IPv6 traffic by configuring a Client Connector Portal setting.
- Includes option to disable parallel IPv6 and IPv4 DNS requests to help interoperability with Cisco AnyConnect VPN.
- Provides ability to configure collection of device location information for the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) service.
- Provides the ability to password protect disabling of the ZDX service.
- Provides the ability to disable Pre-Windows Login machine tunnels on all devices, as configured in the Client Connector Portal.
- Improves the user interface by consolidating Pre-Windows Login IdP authentication and machine tunnel diagnostics as Zscaler Options.
- Provides the ability to stop the machine tunnel for Pre-Windows Login troubleshooting purposes.
- Removes the need to restart the tunnel when switching to Z-Tunnel 2.0 if the previous mode was not using a filter driver.
- Improves the driver installation and repair options.
- Provides option to use a new PAC parser. Customers are encouraged to try the new parser before the existing legacy parser is deprecated.
- Provides the ability to set separate passwords for disabling Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) versus exiting the Zscaler Client Connector application.
- Zscaler Client Connector now continues to run when an RDP session becomes disconnected.
- Supports both old and new thumbprints for the antivirus posture checks, providing flexibility in scheduling antivirus upgrades.
- DNS requests for the hostname-based trusted network evaluation now go through the default adapter.
- Improves accessibility by fixing keyboard navigation on the Notifications and More screens in the Zscaler Client Connector user interface.
- Fixes an issue where ZPA reauthentication notifications were repeatedly prompting users, regardless of the settings.
- Fixes an issue where the user could not succeed with SAML authentication in rare scenarios.
- Zscaler Client Connector now sends DNS traffic to Z-Tunnel 2.0 if the SIPA feature is enabled, even if ZPA has been turned off locally on the system.
- Fixes an issue where VPN hostname bypasses were not followed for DNS traffic when Zscaler Client Connector was running in ZPA mode or running ZIA with Z-Tunnel 2.0.
- Fixes an issue where a tunnel error condition caused the VDI to disconnect.
- Fixes an issue where the user could not log out of Zscaler Client Connector when using the Restore Proxy feature in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where IP addresses in the ZPA app segment were not bypassed from the Zscaler Client Connector client as configured.
- Fixes an issue where the app Log Mode did not reflect the Log Mode setting in the Windows app profile after a device restart.
- Fixes an issue where the device posture check for Firewall did not succeed in cases where the GPO was also configured to enable Firewall.
- Fixes an issue where machine hostname information was not reflected in the status logs.
- Fixes an issue where the arrow back button on the Zscaler Client Connector login page was not easily clickable.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector failed to switch from Off Trusted Network to On Trusted Network with few VPNs on the system.
- Fixes an issue where remote uninstallation of Zscaler Client Connector was incomplete.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not connect seamlessly to the next Private Service Edge when the primary Private Service Edge went down.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.4.1.4 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.4.1.4 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Provides restrictions on user actions for the Pre-Windows Login with IdP feature if the SAML authentication page provides links that open in a new browser instance.
- Fixes a machine tunnel enrollment issue caused by a duplicate hardware ID.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector required re-enrollment for the machine tunnel, even though no timeout policy was configured.
- Fixes a Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) authentication issue where users were prompted to reauthenticate, regardless of the timeout policy setting.
- Fixes a Zscaler Client Connector login issue caused by built-in browser cache not clearing in some instances.
- Fixes an issue where DNS traffic could not successfully route through Z-Tunnel 2.0 when the SIPA feature was enabled.
- Fixes an issue where the app Log Mode did not reflect the Log Mode setting in the Windows app profile when the device was restarted.
- Fixes an issue where IP addresses in the ZPA app segment were not bypassed as configured.
- Fixes an issue where the device posture check for Firewall did not succeed in cases where the GPO was also configured to enable Firewall.
- Fixes an issue where the arrow back button on the Zscaler Client Connector login page was not easily clickable.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 2.3 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 2.3 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Includes Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) error code responses in Zscaler Client Connector logs for troubleshooting purposes.
- Supports both TCP and Adaptive probe types for traceroute.
- Supports reusing URL connection when requests are redirected to the same domain.
- Supports use of cached protocol for traceroute to the egress.
- Supports adaptive traceroute to the egress.
- Supports increasing the packet count to 20 for traceroute probes.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.7
body: - Supports collection of a user’s device location information if Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) has been enabled on the device.
- Supports automated cleanup of inactive devices and permanent deletion of devices removed from the enrolled devices list.
- Supports Microsoft Defender posture check.
- Includes option in Zscaler Service Entitlement to disable the machine tunnel for all devices.
- Includes UI enhancements for Zscaler Service Entitlement settings.
- Improves Certificate Trust posture check by adding Name and Expiry fields for validation.
- General Availability builds can now be enabled under the app store’s New Releases tab without auto-update restrictions. Confirmation messaging has also been added.
- Includes a session timeout warning message after one hour to extend the session via 15-minute increments.
- Includes a Zscaler Digital Experience Version field in the Registered Device Details screen for ZDX customers.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.4.0.124 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.4.0.124 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector encountered a connection error when switching networks in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where Enforce proxy mode was not working when Zscaler Client Connector was upgraded from version 1.4 to 3.1.
- Fixes an issue where the Remote Desktop connection to a device running Zscaler Client Connector required multiple attempts when reconnecting an existing Remote Desktop session.
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) connection to the Private Service Edge was failing, since the first attempt through the external proxy did not succeed.
- Fixes an issue where leveraging the uninstaller process could be used to delete folders in an elevated context. (CVE-2021-26734)

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.6.76
body: - Includes option to set a registry path for the PAC URL in the forwarding profile and app profiles.

- Includes option to configure Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) reauthentication notifications under the System Tray Notification Settings tab. Users can override this setting by configuring notifications in the More screen of the Zscaler Client Connector app.
- Supports CrowdStrike risk score-based posture checks.
- Includes option to block unreachable domains for Z-Tunnel 1.0 and Tunnel with Local Proxy (TWLP) in the forwarding profile.
- Includes option to fetch logs remotely for enrolled devices without user intervention.
- Includes Certificate Revocation List (CRL) check in posture profile to detect revoked certificates.
- Includes option to enable IPv4 over IPv6 in the Windows app profile setting.
- Includes option in the forwarding profile to fall back to TLS or Z-Tunnel 1.0 for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) in case of Z-Tunnel 2.0 failure.
- Supports IPv6 addresses in trusted network and forwarding profile configurations.
- Supports multiple certificate thumbprints for device postures.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 2.2 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 2.2 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Changes the ZDX page fetch probe metrics calculations by excluding discovery time from DNS resolution but including time only for system proxy PAC parsing.
- Supports traceroute to the Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) broker.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.6.73
body: - Includes option to set a registry path for the PAC URL in the forwarding profile and app profiles.

- Includes option to configure Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) reauthentication notifications under the System Tray Notification Settings tab. Users can override this setting by configuring notifications in the More screen of the Zscaler Client Connector app.
- Supports CrowdStrike risk score-based posture checks.
- Includes option to block unreachable domains for Z-Tunnel 1.0 and Tunnel with Local Proxy (TWLP) in the forwarding profile.
- Includes option to fetch logs remotely for enrolled devices without user intervention.
- Includes Certificate Revocation List (CRL) check in posture profile to detect revoked certificates.
- Includes option to enable IPv4 over IPv6 in the Windows app profile setting.
- Includes option in the forwarding profile to fall back to TLS or Z-Tunnel 1.0 for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) in case of Z-Tunnel 2.0 failure.
- Supports IPv6 addresses in trusted network and forwarding profile configurations.
- Supports multiple certificate thumbprints for device postures.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.4 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.4 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Supports installer package specific to commercial customers only. Customers using the Zscaler government cloud should not use this Zscaler Client Connector version.
- Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) module 2.2 for Windows is paired with Zscaler Client Connector 3.4 for Windows.
- Third-party components distributed with Zscaler Client Connector are now code signed.
- The Zscaler Client Connector binaries have mitigations implemented to provide protection against exploitation.
- Upgrades the version of InstallBuilder, which includes several security fixes.
- The uninstaller picks the uninstall password from a more secure location.
- Strengthens the security passwords stored on the disk.

- Includes native IPv6 support for Tunnel with Local Proxy (TWLP), Enforce Proxy, and None modes using NAT64. Currently, upgrades to Zscaler Client Connector version 3.4 from earlier versions are not supported on devices that have IPv6-only connection.
- Includes option to prefer IPv4 over IPv6 for outgoing traffic.

- Includes option to fetch logs remotely for enrolled devices without user intervention for troubleshooting purposes. To learn more, see the Log Details section of Viewing Device Fingerprint for an Enrolled Device.
- Pre-Windows Login machine tunnels now also support private brokers.
- Provides Pre-Windows Login machine tunnel diagnostics options in the Zscaler Client Connector burger menu.
- Includes option to authenticate Pre-Windows Login machine tunnel traffic using the domain IdP.
- Includes support for Pre-Windows Login machine tunnel with external proxy.

- Includes option to configure Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) reauthentication notifications under the System Tray Notification Settings tab. End users can override this setting by configuring notifications in the More screen of the Zscaler Client Connector app. To learn more, see Configuring the Default Notification Setting for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Now supports reading the PAC URL from the registry key. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Supports CrowdStrike risk score-based posture checks for ZPA access. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.
- Includes warning message when manually downgrading Zscaler Client Connector to a lower version. Enhancements for silent downgrades are also included.
- The export logs option in Zscaler Client Connector now also exports event viewer logs for application, system, and setup. It also includes all install and uninstall events.
- Includes Certificate Revocation List (CRL) check in client certificate posture profile to detect revoked certificates. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.

- When using Zscaler Client Connector with Z-Tunnel 2.0, if there are network issues, it automatically falls back from using DTLS to TLS, and then to Z-Tunnel 1.0. With this release, Zscaler Client Connector now supports customizing this fall back behavior. Specifically, when falling back to Z-Tunnel 1.0, you can specify the forwarding behavior for web and non-web traffic. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.
- Changes the ZDX page fetch probe metrics calculations by excluding discovery time from DNS resolution, but including time only for system proxy PAC parsing.
- Limits number of DNS suffixes to 50 per system in support of Windows 10. To learn more, see Upgrading to Windows 10, Version 2004.
- Zscaler Client Connector now prevents end users from changing the compatibility mode on the Zscaler Client Connector executable.
- Includes enhancements in tunnel mode to support Split VPN (exclude routes) by binding to a specific interface.
- Reduces CPU usage when Zscaler Client Connector is running with some UDP applications using Z-Tunnel 2.0.
- Fixes an issue to prevent ZPA route refresh when the network state changes, but the adapter category remains the same.
- Supports the periodic Collect Route Information feature through Z-Tunnel 2.0.
- Resolves a strict enforcement scenario when the app profile PAC file has a default return statement for sending the traffic direct.
- Resolves an issue to stop DNS traffic interception after ZPA goes to a fail open state under full VPN.
- Fixes an issue where outbound DNS requests were missing a few records compared to the requests that Zscaler Client Connector received.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.2.1.1 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.2.1.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where multiple Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) registration requests were issued during a ZPA auto-reauthentication scenario.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector paused in a Connecting state, caused by non-UTF-8 characters in the configuration.
- Fixes an issue where ZPA intermittently encountered a firewall/antivirus (FW/AV) error during a network change.
- Resolves an issue where the machine tunnel stopped if Zscaler Client Connector was installed using a seed domain via a command line argument.
- Resolves an issue where Zscaler Client Connector prompted users for ZPA reauthentication if they exited Zscaler Client Connector immediately after ZPA authentication.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector could not detect the external proxy in Windows 7.
- Fixes issues where Zscaler Client Connector could not detect the external proxy properly in some scenarios.
- Resolves an issue where ZPA remained in a connection state after disconnection from the network.
- Resolves an issue where Zscaler Client Connector encountered an internal error state in some scenarios when intercepting packets.

body: - Includes option to set a registry path for the PAC URL in the forwarding profile and app profiles.

- Includes option to configure Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) reauthentication notifications under the System Tray Notification Settings tab. Users can override this setting by configuring notifications in the More screen of the Zscaler Client Connector app.
- Supports CrowdStrike risk score-based posture checks.
- Includes option to block unreachable domains for Z-Tunnel 1.0 and Tunnel with Local Proxy (TWLP) in the forwarding profile.

entries.status: Release Available: ZDX Module 2.1.0.10 for Windows
