entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.2.0.87 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.2.0.87 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team if you don't see this release enabled for your organization.
Version 3.2.0.87 includes all fixes and enhancements from version 3.1.0.129. To learn more, see Zscaler Client Connector 3.1.0.129 Enhancements and Fixes.
- Includes support of machine tunneling to ZPA resources before login to Windows (also referred to as Pre-Windows Login). To learn more, see About Machine Tunnels.
- Fixes an issue where packet capture stopped working when users logged in to Zscaler Client Connector after logging out with their one-time password.
- Fixes an issue where packet capture stopped working when users logged in to Zscaler Client Connector after sleep mode.
- Fixes an issue where a file path caused the posture check to not work under a C:\Windows\System32 folder.
- Fixes a file extension issue for process snapshots.
- Fixes an issue where packet capture did not work for some users after upgrading to version 3.1 if an old version of the packet capture library resided on the system.
- Fixes an issue where a script error was displayed for single sign-on authentication in some scenarios.
- Fixes an error when a Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) traceroute probe was enabled with the Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) domain.
- Fixes an issue where an authentication error was displayed due to a Zscaler Client Connector connection issue in some instances.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector displayed incorrect characters in AUP messages.
- Fixes an issue where in some scenarios, gaps were seen in the metrics graphs periodically within the ZDX user interface.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector displayed a connection error as being Off Trusted Network when using Citrix VPN in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where a network change on a non-primary adapter caused Zscaler Client Connector Z-Tunnel 2.0 to reconnect.
- Includes an upgraded packet capture library to the latest version.
- Allows you to save and restore the system proxy settings via the app profile.
- Includes support for DNS domains via the app profile.
- Fixes an issue where a required logout password was bypassed.
- Fixes a service controller issue where memory usage increased when using ZDX.
- Fixes an issue where the SQL application slowed when running Zscaler Client Connector.
- Fixes an instance where the Zscaler Client Connector version was hidden when Zscaler Client Connector was installed from the command line.
- Fixes a Z-Tunnel 2.0 issue where the traffic was blocked upon system wakeup.
- Fixes a policy parsing issue in a certain scenario where a device hostname contained a special character.
- Fixes a root CA issue where the client certificate was not recognized in the posture check.
- Fixes a Zscaler Client Connector upgrade issue in some scenarios when using pre-Windows login, due to credential provider locking issues.
- Fixes an issue where the user had to log in to Client Connector after reboot, even though the user was previously logged in for special hardware scenarios.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.6
body: - Build versions are now sorted by version number, rather than timestamp.
- Includes option to bypass IPv6-only destination traffic for Z-Tunnel 1.0 in the forwarding profile.
- The minimum timeout value for DTLS and TLS fallback is now 5 seconds (instead of 2 seconds) for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) tunneling in the forwarding profile.
- Includes option to enable Limited Availability releases from the Client Connector App Store.
- Includes option to enable and select dedicated proxy ports in the Administration settings.
- Includes option to configure IdP authentication via a machine tunnel.
- Fixes an issue where names of inactive users appeared in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.1.0.129 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.1.0.129 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Adds a button within the More menu option of the Zscaler Client Connector app for users to configure Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) reauthentication notifications. This helps with managing background applications that try to reach out to the server side through ZPA when Zscaler Client Connector is in a ZPA reauthentication stage.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not launch upon system reboot in some rare scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector displayed an incorrect service state for Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) if the ZDX module was upgraded when ZDX was turned off.
- Fixes an issue where the ZPA auto-reauthentication feature required users to open the Zscaler Client Connector client for the authentication flow to complete.
- Fixes an issue where the system encountered a network error when using TLS with Z-Tunnel 2.0 in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where an RDP connection did not succeed on a custom port.
- Fixes an issue where certain IP-based ZPA internal application traffic was incorrectly routed via Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Client Connector installer aborted on some restricted operating systems without a warning.
- Fixes an issue where the ZSATrayManager service encountered an error condition due to certificate issues.
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Client Connector application was not launching in a Unified Write Filter (UWF) environment due to a Windows limitation.
- Fixes an issue where the PAC file was not set correctly during the network state change if the network came up after a delay, post-reboot.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.1.0.117 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.1.0.117 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an upgrade failure issue in some scenarios due to DNS latency.
- Fixes an issue where periodic validation of the posture profile caused intermittent disconnection from Zscaler Private Access (ZPA).
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and ZPA services moved into an OFF state in some instances immediately after upgrading or logging back in to Windows.

- Fixes an issue where a downgrade from version 3.1 resulted in multiple configuration files that caused ZPA connection errors. Zscaler recommends uninstalling the current version before installing an earlier version. To learn more, see Downgrading Zscaler Client Connector to an Earlier Version.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not clear the DNS suffixes in some scenarios when ZPA moved into a disabled state.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.1.0.111 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.1.0.111 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where the myIPAddress PAC function was not returning the default interface IP address in cases with full VPN tunnel mode.
- Fixes an issue where posture check did not succeed for the Microsoft Base Smart Card provider.

- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) briefly went into a Connecting state in some instances during ZPA auto-reauthentication.
- Fixes an issue where posture check did not succeed for legacy (Crypto API) providers.
- Fixes an issue where a change to the log mode in the Zscaler Client Connector app profile did not reflect the changed log mode in the Zscaler Client Connector user interface.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector was not intercepting traffic in some instances after users logged back in to Zscaler Client Connector.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector was not intercepting traffic in some instances after the device woke from sleep mode.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector startup was momentarily delayed due to tunnel startup operations taking longer than usual in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector wrongly intercepted traffic on all adapters when the default adapter was a PPP adapter.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.1.0.103 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.1.0.103 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team if you don't see this release enabled for your organization.
- Fixes a timing issue that resulted in connection errors while accessing Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) applications when Posture Checks were in use.
- Fixes an issue where process-based Posture Checks were not working correctly.
- Fixes an issue that prevented Zscaler Client Connector upgrade in a rare instance where the termination process had not completed.
- Fixes an issue where a user could not log in to ZScaler Client Connector when multiple proxies were configured.
- Fixes an issue where a user login would fail with error 10110 when the autofill username option was used in some instances.
- Fixes an issue where the Registry Key-based Posture Checks were not working with ZPA device Posture Check policies.
- Fixes an issue where the tray icon was greyed out after Client Connector was running for a few days.

Version 3.1.0.103 includes all fixes and enhancements from version 3.1 and version 3.1.0.96. This includes the following issues fixed in version 3.1. To learn more, see Zscaler Client Connector 3.1 Enhancements and Fixes and Zscaler Client Connector 3.1.0.96 Enhancements and Fixes.
- Fixes an issue where in some instances an environment variable could be abused on Windows operating systems. (CVSS - 5.6)
- Hardens some components of Zscaler Client Connector which could be susceptible to exploitation on Windows operating systems. (CVE-2020-11635)
- Hardens security for the inter process communication to prevent exploitation on Windows operating systems. (CVSS - 7.3)

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.1.0.96 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.1.0.96 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team if you don't see this release enabled for your organization.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector displayed incorrect AUP messages.
- Restores certificate-based posture functionality when the posture is validated against a root certificate.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not launch after upgrade.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector displayed a connection error after Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) reauthentication.
- Fixes an issue where the One Time Password for uninstall was not working after upgrading Zscaler Client Connector.
- Restores custom certificate support when using certificates with the .CER format.

All fixes and enhancements within version 3.1 were included in version 3.1.0.96. This includes the following issues fixed in version 3.1. To learn more, see Zscaler Client Connector 3.1 Enhancements and Fixes.
- Fixes an issue where in some instances an environment variable could be abused on Windows operating systems. (CVSS - 5.6)
- Hardens some components of Zscaler Client Connector which could be susceptible to exploitation on Windows operating systems. (CVE-2020-11635)
- Hardens security for the inter process communication to prevent exploitation on Windows operating systems. (CVSS - 7.3)

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 3.1 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team if you don't see this release enabled for your organization.

- Introduces an architecture change to allow for improved security posture. This change adds a new service ZSATrayManager that must be placed on the allowlist. To learn more, see Zscaler Client Connector Processes to Allowlist.
- Hardens some components of Zscaler Client Connector which could be susceptible to exploitation on Windows operating systems. (CVE-2020-11635)
- Hardens security for the inter process communication to prevent exploitation on Windows operating systems. (CVSS - 7.3)
- Fixes an issue where in some instances an environment variable could be abused on Windows operating systems. (CVSS - 5.6)
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Client Connector update failed when it coincided with user enrollment.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector incorrectly indicated a ZPA reauthentication warning in the System Tray even though the user was in a trusted network.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector sometimes failed to delete the filters corresponding to ZPA applications when ZPA was turned off or in fail-open state.
- Fixes an issue where Symantec AV version 14.2 was blocking the ZSATray process from coming up.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector logged out due to a local configuration decryption failure when the CPU ID on the system changed.
- Zscaler Client Connector now evaluates the posture as non-compliant if the intermediate CA or the root CA is not installed when the certificate chain installed on the system is incomplete.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector logged out due to local configuration decryption failure when the battery was removed or changed on the system.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.0.2 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.0.2 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.
- Zscaler Client Connector now evaluates postures on a periodic basis.
- Zscaler Client Connector now supports posture checks for client certificates in the system certificate store.
- Improves interoperability for AD users.
- Improves performance for ZPA applications that open a high number of sockets.
- Zscaler Client Connector now supports restoring the previous system proxy settings upon exiting based on the app profile settings.
- Fixes an issue where some ZPA users faced connection errors when using double quotes in a posture profile.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector requests to maintain connections resulted in authentication issues in certain situations.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector encountered an error condition during application exit.
- Fixes an issue where Microsoft applications were not able to operate when loopback exemptions were enabled on systems shared by multiple users.
- Fixes an AD interoperability issue in cases where the systems of newly synced users could not reach AD during authentication.
- Improves the ZPA re-authentication notifications by periodically prompting the user to re-authenticate.
- Fixes an issue where auto update failed on Windows 7 clients running Zscaler Client Connector 1.5.0.337.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector displayed incorrect AUP messages.
- Fixes an issue where a system crash was observed while Zscaler Client Connector was retrieving interface information.
- PCAP file size is now increased to 500 MB from 100 MB.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.5
body: - Supports posture checks for detecting the ownership of the device. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.
- Includes support for DTLS 1.2 protocol.

- Allows you to enable or disable the automatic population of the username field in your organization’s IdP login form. To learn more, see Configuring Automatic Username Population for IdP Authentication.
- Supports bypassing applications for Z-Tunnel 2.0 configuration in the app profile. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles and About Application Bypass Info.
- Supports forwarding the user traffic to a dedicated proxy port through Zscaler Client Connector.
- Supports inclusion and exclusion of DNS domains in the app profile for Z-Tunnel 2.0 configuration. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Allows you to save and restore the system proxy settings via the app profile. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.

- Includes multiple custom Time Range filters and options to search for audit entries based on Client IP, Resource, or Admin ID in the Audit Logs page. You can also export the audit entries. Audit logs are now stored for up to 6 months. To learn more, see About Audit Logs.
- Supports adding ports in the Destination Exclusions field for the macOS app profile. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.

- Supports Machine Tokens, which provides authentication capabilities for Windows devices. You can use Machine Tokens in Zscaler Client Connector profile rules for Windows. To use this feature, you need to configure Machines groups and Machine Provisioning keys in the ZPA Admin Portal.
- Supports tracking of devices using Machine Tunnels.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.0.0.303 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.0.0.303 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.4
body: - Zscaler Client Connector now supports automatic reauthentication attempts for users with ZPA. For more information, see Configuring Automatic ZPA Reauthentication.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 2.2.1.77 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.2.1.77 Enhancements and Fixes
body: This is a service update for Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) 2.2.1. Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector was not automatically upgraded to a new version when the network resulted in HTTP fragmentation.
- Fixes an issue where the ZPA application traffic based on IP address was not properly routed through the tunnel.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 2.1.2.113 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.2.113 Enhancements and Fixes
body: This is a service update for Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) 2.1.2. Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector was not automatically upgraded to a new version when the network resulted in HTTP fragmentation.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 3.0 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 3.0 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.
- Fixes an issue where Z-Tunnel 2.0 failed to recover from an error condition in a certain scenario.
- Fixes an issue where the Z-Tunnel 2.0 connection retries failed in certain scenarios.
- Includes support for segmented HTTP requests in Tunnel, TWLP, and auto upgrade scenarios.
- Zscaler Client Connector now supports DNS traffic for ZPA domains over TCP.
- Zscaler Client Connector now allows you to select the Zscaler cloud that you want to connect to.
- Zscaler Client Connector now displays the username either as the logged in user name or as the authenticated user ID based on the Zscaler Client Connector Portal settings.
- Zscaler Client Connector now supports DTLS 1.2 protocol.
- Zscaler Client Connector enhances secure communications between application components.
- Zscaler Client Connector now supports automatic ZPA reauthentication for SSO clients.
- Includes improvements to support dedicated Z-Tunnel 2.0 Public Service Edge hardware.
- Fixes an issue where file download from Zscaler Client Connector failed in certain scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where JDBC connection failed over ZPA with a socket error on Zscaler Client Connector.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector logs displayed incorrect hostnames.
- Zscaler Client Connector now uses the cached app profile PAC when an intermittent PAC file download fails.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector failed to load after a device reboot in certain scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where some connections were failing through Z-Tunnel 1.0 due to segmented HTTP requests.
- Fixes an issue where traceroutes failed between Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX in certain scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where third-party VPN clients randomly disconnected with Zscaler Client Connector due to simultaneous access to resources.
- Fixes an issue where the username field was pre-populated with the user’s email address during ZPA SSO reauthentication in Zscaler Client Connector.
- Fixes an issue with file transfers through ZPA when using double encryption for the FTP application.
- Zscaler Client Connector no longer performs DNS resolution for mobilesupport.zscaler.com when support access is disabled
- Fixes an issue where the users were unable to start the packet capture option from Zscaler Client Connector when ZDX service was enabled.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector stopped forwarding traffic when the device was in sleep mode.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not reflect the updated group ID information.
- Fixes an issue where remote uninstallation of Zscaler Client Connector was incomplete.
- Improves the interoperability with VPN clients when the 100.64.x.x IP subnet is overlapping between VPN and Zscaler Client Connector.
- Zscaler Client connector now includes the end user email address with the Report an Issue option.
- Zscaler Client Connector now binds to the loopback address to serve PAC files and to intercept the loopback traffic in local proxy mode.
- Includes updates to third party libraries and components to enhance security.
- Improves the ZPA re-authentication flow after the user enters credentials in the IDP page.
- Zscaler Client Connector now includes dump files when the users export logs for troubleshooting purposes.
- Zscaler Client Connector improves the connection status change notifications when using the accessibility feature.
- Zscaler Client Connector now supports ZPA applications that are defined using a wildcard (e.g., *). To learn more, see Configuring Application Segments.
This configuration method requires approval from Zscaler prior to implementation.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 2.2.1.63 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.2.1.63 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 2.2.1.55 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.2.1.55 Enhancements and Fixes

- Fixes an issue where ADFS authentication failed on Zscaler Client Connector.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 2.1.2.112 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.2.112 Enhancements and Fixes
body: This is a service update for Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) 2.1.2. Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.4

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 2.2.1 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.2.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.

- Zscaler Client Connector now includes support for the Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) service. This module will not be installed unless it is enabled, and specific destination domains must be placed on the allowlist in your SSL bypass list. To learn more, contact the Zscaler Account team.

- Fixes an issue with the driver installation on Zscaler Client Connector while using the Repair App option.
- Fixes an issue where installing Zscaler Client Connector triggers too many processes on users' devices.
- Fixes an issue where the Process Check device posture failed when the process was launched using command line arguments.
- Zscaler Client Connector is now upgraded to the NPCAP version 0.9995 and Install builder version 20.4.
- Fixes an issue where a script error popped up while logging in to the Zscaler Client Connector.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not clear the DNS suffix list when ZPA was disabled.
- Fixes an issue where domain validation for service record lookup failed in Zscaler Client Connector for ZPA users.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector failed to load after a device restart.
- Fixes an issue where the Zscaler Client Connector re-authentication alert was not displayed on the system tray.
- Fixes an issue where the users randomly lost connectivity while switching networks.
- Zscaler Client Connector now includes additional validation for remote procedure calls (RPC).
- ZDX module of the Zscaler Client Connector now provides detailed information for all the traceroute hops.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 2.1.3.25 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.3.25 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector failed to install the SSL certificate in some scenarios.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector could not establish connections on operating systems using a locale other than English.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.3
body: - Updates the digital signatures for Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) policy response payload.

- Improves the Update Settings for Zscaler Client Connector automatic rollout. When you have the Always Latest Version auto-update option enabled, now your devices are updated over a period of time. To learn more, see Configuring Update Settings for Zscaler Client Connector.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 2.1.3 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.3 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) now includes additional validation for remote procedure calls (RPC) and enhancements for server-based integrity checks.
- Fixes an issue with the ZIA service where an internal application didn’t load on the first request.
- Fixes an issue where an error occurred with the ZSATunnel process when using packet capture.
- Fixes an issue where after canceling a machine reboot, Zscaler Client Connector sent traffic directly for approximately one minute.
- Fixes an issue where the ZPA service was disabled, but Zscaler Client Connector displayed a reauthentication warning for ZPA.
- Fixes an issue where, in some scenarios, the ZIA service was stuck in a connecting state after installing Zscaler Client Connector.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 2.1.2.105 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.2.105 Enhancements and Fixes

- Fixes an unquoted service path vulnerability. (Zscaler acknowledges Ryan Schachtschneider and the Lockheed Martin Red Team for independently disclosing this vulnerability.) (CVE-2020-11632)
- Fixes a DLL hijacking vulnerability due to the configuration of OpenSSL. (Zscaler acknowledges Xavier Danest for responsibly disclosing this vulnerability.) (CVE-2020-11634)

- Fixes an OpenSSL configuration issue with DLL loading.
- Zscaler Client Connector is now compiled with additional binary protection flags.
- Fixes an issue that could cause Zscaler Client Connector to load an incorrect DLL.
- Fixes an issue by including additional validation for registry key values.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 2.1.2.92 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.2.92 Enhancements and Fixes
body: This is a service update for Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) 2.1.2. Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector displayed the Logout Password prompt instead of the Disable Password prompt for users exiting Zscaler Client Connector.
- Fixes an issue where users experienced an internal Zscaler Client Connector error with Zscaler Internet Security when using Zoom.
- Fixes an issue where, in a certain scenario, Zscaler Client Connector was configured to use Z-Tunnel 2.0 for DTLS but switched to Z-Tunnel 1.0 instead.
- Improves upload and download speeds for Z-Tunnel 2.0 in different bandwidth networks for both TLS and DTLS.
- Fixes an issue where users experienced a firewall error with Zscaler Client Connector in Tunnel mode when using Check Point VPN.
- Improves UDP application performance for the ZPA service.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 2.1.2.84 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.2.84 Enhancements and Fixes
body: This is a service update for Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) 2.1.2. Contact the Zscaler Account team to enable this release for your organization.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector accidentally intercepted and tunneled sessions established from a server to a client application.
- Improves network performance for using the ZPA service with the packet filter driver and a high number of defined IP-based applications segments with ports and protocols.

- Fixes an issue with using keyboard navigation on the Private Access window within the Zscaler Client Connector user interface. You can now access all the UI elements for Zscaler Client Connector with the Tab key.

entries.status: Release Available
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector Portal 3.17.2
body: - When you create a new Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) profile rule or delete a group from an existing one, the Zscaler Client Connector profiles policy now assigns rules to no groups by default. Before this release, it assigned rules to all groups by default. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Adds support for using multiple identity providers with the ZIA service.
- Fixes an issue where sometimes automatic device removal did not work and devices became stuck in the Device Removal Pending state.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 2.1.2.81 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.2.81 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Fixes a potential buffer overflow vulnerability when connecting to misconfigured TLS servers. (Zscaler acknowledges the Siemens Red Team for responsibly disclosing this vulnerability.) (CVE-2020-11633)
- Adds resilience for when a user's device switches from Enforced Proxy mode to Z-Tunnel 2.0 mode.
- Fixes an issue where, in some scenarios, Zscaler Client Connector did not download an updated forwarding profile PAC file after a network change.
- Fixes an issue where a matching subdomain did not pass the Domain Joined device posture profile.
- Fixes an issue where sometimes the Client Certificate device posture profile did not work.
- Fixes an issue where, in some scenarios, Zscaler Client Connector could not handle TLS hostname identification.

entries.status: Release in Limited Availability: Client Connector 2.1.2 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1.2 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Zscaler Client Connector exported logs are no longer encrypted. However, logs included in the Report an Issue form are still encrypted.
- Exported logs now include crash dumps and pcaps files.
- Includes improvements for Z-Tunnel 2.0 gateway selection and DTLS to TLS fallback.
- Adds support for ZPA Private Service Edges.
- Zscaler Client Connector now displays service maintenance notifications during upgrades.
- Adds support for Zscaler Client Connector to tunnel internal traffic through Zscaler. To learn more, see Configuring Zscaler Client Connector Profiles.
- Adds support for the Process Check, Carbon Black, Crowdstrike, and SentinelOne options for device posture profiles. To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles for ZPA.

- Adds support for Zscaler Client Connector to automatically lower MTU based on the forwarding profile configuration to prevent IP fragmentation. To learn more, see Configuring Forwarding Profiles for Zscaler Client Connector.

- For the Windows version of Zscaler Client Connector, adds support for accessibility features, including screen readers (e.g., Narrator), keyboard navigators, application and text size changes, and high contrast themes.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector could launch applications in the system context. (CVSS v3.1 Base Score: 8.2 - High)
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector in Tunnel with Local Proxy mode did not change the URI to a relative path.
- Fixes an issue where Z-Tunnel 2.0 did not work when using Windows Hello on Kerberos.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector switched between gateway.cloudname.net and the default PROXY statement when the PAC file was invalid or contained syntax errors.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector did not give users, who passed the device posture profile check for certificates, access to ZPA applications.
- Fixes an issue where, in some cases, Zscaler Client Connector sent ZIA traffic or ZPA traffic direct instead of tunneling the traffic.
- Fixes an issue where the ZPA service did not resolve DNS for SRV records.
- Fixes an issue for the macOS version of Zscaler Client Connector where Zscaler Client Connector did not uninstall when a shell script was used.
- Fixes an issue for the macOS version of Zscaler Client Connector where Zscaler Client Connector still opened after installing the app in silent mode.

entries.status: Release Available: Client Connector 2.1 for Windows
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 2.1 Enhancements and Fixes
body: - Now displays the name of the broker that Zscaler Client Connector (Z App) is connected to in the Private Access window.
- Allows you to configure multiple trusted networks for use with ZPA applications. To learn more, see About Trusted Networks.

- Allows you to configure Zscaler Client Connector to automatically populate the username field during IdP authentication. To learn more, see Configure Automatic Username Population for IdP Authentication.
- The Disable Loopback Restriction option now works independently of the forwarding profile action. Before this release, this setting only worked with Tunnel with Local Proxy mode.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector couldn’t detect the captive portal due to some airlines' Wi-Fi settings.
- Fixes an issue where, in some cases, Zscaler Client Connector was stuck in a connecting state when using Z-Tunnel 2.0.
- Fixes an issue where sometimes Zscaler Client Connector didn't resolve internal DNS domains when ZPA was in a fail-open state.
- Fixes an issue where Zscaler Client Connector didn’t immediately enforce a new PAC file after the device reboots.
